signature: SUBROUTINE ZLAHR2( N, K, NB, A, LDA, TAU, T, LDT, Y, LDY )

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A.

params.name: K
params.reference: The offset for the reduction. Elements below the k-th subdiagonal in the first `NB` columns are reduced to zero. $K < N$.

params.name: nb
params.reference: The number of columns to be reduced.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the n-by-(n-k+1) general matrix A. On exit, the elements on and above the k-th subdiagonal in the first `NB` columns are overwritten with the corresponding elements of the reduced matrix; the elements below the k-th subdiagonal, with the array `TAU`, represent the matrix Q as a product of elementary reflectors. The other columns of A are unchanged. See Further Details.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: TAU
params.reference: The scalar factors of the elementary reflectors. See Further Details.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge \mathrm{NB}$.

params.name: ldy
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Y. $\mathrm{LDY} \ge N$.
